description: Wave readiness. A wave may pin its source commit only when every listed bead has required_status at that commit's .beads/issues.jsonl export. bead_ids are full beads identifiers. Issue count never changes wave count.

U1.acceptance_check: Destination-authored control files only; no upstream dependency.

U2.acceptance_check: Four active commons crates compile and test through the destination workspace; golden vectors byte-identical.

U3.acceptance_check: Rust module host epic (c50) and shared-memory IPC epic (ymc) closed; host-runtime, transport, tokenizer vectors pass from destination-only sources.

U4.acceptance_check: Semantic kernel epic closed through daemon routes (kh8.8) and rip-out (kh8.9); every persistent family has a class contract.

U5.acceptance_check: Rust parity epic (pml) and retrieval epic (3q5) closed; no unclassified TypeScript mutation path remains.

U7.acceptance_check: No readiness beads beyond U5; permanent TypeScript surfaces and packaging land.

U8.acceptance_check: All gating beads of U3, U4, U5 closed at the final reconciled commit.

non_gating.rationale: Action-triggered memory epic; code migrates only if closed before its owning wave pins, else work continues in Eidnara after cutover.
GPU Synapse epic; genesis release ships linux-x64-gnu CPU only.
